name: GP Corrugated Box Plant - Waxahachie TX

fieldNotes.location: Roster had no street address; coords pointed at open farmland ~7 km off (geocode moved 7299 m). Actual GP Corrugated box plant is at 5800 N Interstate Hwy 35E, Waxahachie TX 75165, on the west side of I-35E north of Waxahachie between FM-387 and FM-406. Confirmed via Waxahachie Chamber of Commerce and business listings; locked center ~32.4420,-96.8480.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open driveway access from the I-35E frontage road; chain-link perimeter fencing present but no barrier arm, sliding gate or guard booth resolved at the road in Street View. Typical un-gated Texas industrial-plant entry. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth visible at the driveways.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Large dedicated trailer-storage yards: dozens of trailers parked in marked angled rows along the building's NW and W sides; substantial drop-yard operation for a corrugated box plant.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 80+ trailers staged across the drop yards in the captured imagery.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Trailers backed into a long dock bank along the building's NE face plus additional dock activity; estimated 25-50 dock doors for this large box plant.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly resolved; box plants generally do not weigh — left false.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Shipping and receiving appear to run from the same general dock complex; not clearly two separate banks.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail line runs along the E edge of the property with a spur (visible in satellite).
fieldNotes.urbanRural: On the edge of Waxahachie along I-35E in an industrial corridor with adjacent distribution warehouses but surrounded by farmland; judged Rural per the small-town tie-breaker, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large monolithic manufacturing building (with attached process/utility structures at the SW); counted as 1.
